note: Approximate reference rates ONLY, for comparing a programme fee with an applicant budget in a different currency. Rates are rounded to three significant figures and are deliberately coarse: they must never be presented as exact, and a converted figure must always be labelled approximate (e.g. 'about GBP 4,000'). A fee is never judged a mismatch on a converted comparison; when a currency has no rate here the fee rule is UNKNOWN.
source: Mid-market rates retrieved 26 Nov 2026 from exchangerates.org.uk, forexinvestors.com and Finnhub (see docs/FX_RATES.md).
